faq.question: What do healthcare & aged care organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 11 healthcare & aged care use cases. The most common are work & project management (9), CRM (5), service management (4), most often for marketing, projects & PMO, operations & delivery teams.

faq.question: How long does a healthcare & aged care monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete healthcare & aged care build is 3 to 6 months. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do healthcare & aged care builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in healthcare & aged care use cases are Outlook shared inbox, SQL Server, Power BI, Outlook/Teams, SharePoint, Employment Hero.
